steps.code:
{"app": "shell", "action": "command", "command": "cat > /tmp/make_pdfs.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
BASE=tasks/3-10/testbed/data
EML=tasks/3-10/testbed/emails/Alice
for f in $EML/*.eml; do
  id=$(basename "$f" .eml)
  # determine recipient from To: line
  to=$(grep -m1 '^To:' "$f" | sed 's/^To: *//' | tr -d '\r')
  if [[ "$to" == *"Alice"* ]]; then rec=Alice; else rec=Bob; fi
  # extract body: lines after first blank line after headers
  awk 'BEGIN{hdr=1} /^$/{if(hdr){hdr=0; next}} !hdr{print}' "$f" > /tmp/email_body.txt
  # create a simple text file with headers and body
  {
    echo "From: $(grep -m1 '^From:' "$f" | sed 's/^From: *//')"
    echo "To: $to"
    echo "Subject: $(grep -m1 '^Subject:' "$f" | sed 's/^Subject: *//')"
    echo ""
    cat /tmp/email_body.txt
  } > /tmp/email.txt
  # convert to pdf using libreoffice
  soffice --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir "$BASE/$rec" /tmp/email.txt >/dev/null 2>&1
  mv "$BASE/$rec/email.pdf" "$BASE/$rec/$id.pdf"
done
EOF
bash /tmp/make_pdfs.sh && echo done"}

{"app": "shell", "action": "command", "command": "python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import os, glob, re
base = 'tasks/3-10/testbed/data'
eml_dir = 'tasks/3-10/testbed/emails/Alice'
for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(eml_dir, '*.eml')):
    eid = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(f))[0]
    with open(f) as fh:
        content = fh.read()
    # parse headers
    lines = content.split('\n')
    headers = {}
    body_lines = []
    in_body = False
    for line in lines:
        if not in_body:
            if line.strip() == '':
                in_body = True
                continue
            if ':' in line:
                k, v = line.split(':', 1)
                headers[k.strip().lower()] = v.strip()
        else:
            body_lines.append(line)
    to = headers.get('to', '')
    rec = 'Alice' if 'alice' in to.lower() else 'Bob'
    outdir = os.path.join(base, rec)
    os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
    txt = f"From: {headers.get('from','')}\nTo: {to}\nSubject: {headers.get('subject','')}\n\n" + '\n'.join(body_lines)
    txtpath = f'/tmp/{eid}.txt'
    with open(txtpath, 'w') as fh:
        fh.write(txt)
    print(eid, rec)
PYEOF"}
